rules.rule: Run the project gate first, from the document's directory
must: Run\ the\ gate,\ walking\ up\ from\ the\ document's\ directory

rules.rule: Exactly one change per proposal, applied only on explicit approval, never batched
must: Propose\ exactly\ one\ change
Apply\ only\ on\ explicit\ approval
never\ batch\ unrelated\ changes

rules.rule: Each fact the change writes or its section states is looked up before the proposal
must: Look\ up\ before\ proposing
each\ the\ section\ it\ touches\ states

rules.rule: Write no fact neither the corpus nor the user gives; an unconfirmed one stays and becomes a gap
must: Write\ no\ fact\ neither\ the\ corpus\ nor\ the\ user\ gives
leave\ the\ text\ unchanged\ and\ hand\ the\ gap\ to\ `srd:report\-doc\-gap`

rules.rule: Gaps are captured and filed only through srd:report-doc-gap, which dedups by list_gaps query and adds a hit on a repeat
must: Never\ capture\ or\ file\ a\ gap\ yourself:\ `srd:report\-doc\-gap`\ does
It\ dedups\ by\ `list_gaps`\ `query`\ and\ takes\ a\ hit\ on\ a\ repeat

rules.rule: A gap about this document carries its identity as doc_id
must: Pass\ `doc_id`\ the\ identity\ and\ `heading_path`\ the\ section\ when\ the\ gap\ is\ about\ this\ document

rules.rule: Fill only from a corpus section outside initiatives; never a URL, _inbox.md, an SRD, or an unconfirmed fact
must: Never\ fill\ from\ a\ URL,\ `_inbox\.md`,\ a\ document\ under\ `initiatives`,\ or\ an\ unconfirmed\ fact

rules.rule: filled_by is <identity>#<heading-slug>, the id never the path
must: `<identity>\#<heading\-slug>`\ of\ the\ section\ that\ now\ states\ it
The\ identity\ is\ the\ `id`,\ never\ the\ `path`

rules.rule: Part of the fact is a partial fill with remaining
must: part:\ `complete:\ false`,\ `remaining`\ what\ is\ still\ missing

rules.rule: A fact homed in the KB fills only once srd:kb has it on a topic page; the inbox fills nothing
must: only\ once\ it\ sits\ on\ a\ topic\ page
In\ `_inbox\.md`:\ no\ fill;\ the\ gap\ stays\ open

rules.rule: A KB page is written only by srd:kb
must: A\ page\ under\ `kb`:\ propose\ here,\ write\ nothing;\ `srd:kb`\ writes\ it

rules.rule: A document under initiatives is handed to srd:edit
must: A\ document\ under\ `initiatives`\ is\ an\ SRD:\ invoke\ `srd:edit`

rules.rule: Never adds, removes, or changes front matter or a marker
must: Never\ add,\ remove,\ or\ change\ front\ matter\ or\ a\ marker

rules.rule: Never wontfixes or reopens a gap; that is srd:backlog
must: never\ wontfix\ or\ reopen\ one\ \(that\ is\ `srd:backlog`\)

rules.rule: A synced page edit reaches its source only when the user pushes it; no publish proposals
must: reaches\ its\ source\ only\ when\ the\ user\ pushes\ it\ upstream
Never\ propose\ publishing,\ pushing,\ or\ syncing

rules.rule: Source conflicts settle by rank, never by folder name
must: the\ lower\ `rank`\ states\ the\ platform
Never\ settle\ by\ folder\ name

rules.rule: No hard-coded trust order, folder name, or sync tool
